title: Full cover letter from a fact list
prompt_text: Write a complete cover letter of 120 to 200 words from these facts, and these facts only. The applicant worked two years as a data scientist at a retailer, where their demand-forecasting model improved stock accuracy by 11 per cent. They took an eight-month career break in 2024 for caring responsibilities. They designed and taught a six-week internal Python course to twelve colleagues. They are applying for a Junior Machine Learning Engineer role at a renewable-energy company. The advert asks for PyTorch and German at B2 level. The applicant has used PyTorch only in personal projects and speaks German at C1. Rules: mention the career break honestly in a single sentence, do not claim professional PyTorch experience, no superlatives or intensifiers (such as best, most, passionate, extremely), no bullet points, no invented names for the employer, the applicant, the retailer or the projects. Use placeholders in square brackets for names.

content:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to apply for the Junior Machine Learning Engineer position at [Employer Name], a renewable-energy company. With two years of experience as a data scientist at [Retailer Name], I have developed practical skills in building predictive models that support operational efficiency. During my tenure, I designed a demand-forecasting model that improved stock accuracy by eleven percent.

I took an eight-month career break in 2024 for caring responsibilities. Following this period, I designed and taught a six-week internal Python course to twelve colleagues. While my professional background uses established machine learning frameworks, I have applied PyTorch exclusively in personal projects to strengthen my deep learning workflow. I also speak German at a C1 level, which meets your B2 requirement.

I welcome the opportunity to contribute my forecasting experience and technical training background to your team. Thank you for reviewing my application. I look forward to discussing how my skills align with your engineering objectives.

Sincerely,
[Applicant Name]
